messages.author: 958272119e13f0e7
messages.subject: 4D models in INLA
parts:
Hi,

I am working on a problem with INLA that has, in its essence, four dimensions involved
* longitude & latitude
* day
* year

I am modelling my response in terms of a space-day term, with an spde in space and an AR1 process in days. This is working well, and at the moment I have one individual model for each year. However, this also means that the parameters of the model (e.g. correlation terms, overdispersion, fixed effects) are estimated separately for each year. Instead, I would prefer to have these estimated in one "grand" model spanning across all years, where I have one independent 3D (space-day) field  for each year - it is not necessary to consider correlations between years, although it would be a bonus if possible.

Is there a way where such a model can be constructed in INLA? I see, for example, that inla.spde.make.index() supports "replicates" but I can't quite tell if they are relevant in this case...

Cheers,

Mark

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] 4D models in INLA
parts:
Hi Mark,

Yes, replicate/repl is the feature that provides precisely such models.

Finn
